truths.truth: An unreachable winning arm nulls its slot, names the tool in warnings[], and takes no lower arm (AC1)
truths.evidence: Live probe on a fixture tree carrying pyproject.toml [tool.ruff] + go.mod with ruff absent from PATH and no node_modules: `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs detect-commands --root .` answered {"lint":null,"typecheck":null,"source":{"lint":null,"typecheck":null},"warnings":["lint: ruff is not on PATH or in node_modules/.bin, so `ruff check .` (from pyproject.toml) was not offered; no lower arm was taken in its place", ...]} - `go vet ./...` was NOT substituted. Implementation: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2645-2662 (`offer()` returns {command:null,source:null} and pushes the warning; provenance is dropped with the command). Named test `detect-commands: an unreachable winning arm nulls its slot and never falls through` (planning.test.mjs:5368) passes.

truths.truth: In this repository detect-commands returns `npx tsc -p tsconfig.ci.json` with tsc absent from PATH and present at node_modules/.bin/tsc (AC2)
truths.evidence: Live in /code/cadence: `detect-commands --root .` -> {"ok":true,"lint":null,"typecheck":"npx tsc -p tsconfig.ci.json","source":{"typecheck":"tsconfig.ci.json"}}; `command -v tsc` finds nothing, `node_modules/.bin/tsc` is a live symlink to ../typescript/bin/tsc. The delegated-tool half is at planning.mjs:2622-2639 (`needs()` splits an `npx <tool>` arm into driver + delegate) and the directory half at lib/on-path.mjs:65-71 (`executableIn`). MEASURED LIMITATION, already disclosed as SUMMARY open item (D-04 refutation): the probe is root-only, so a root whose node_modules sits in an ANCESTOR - a git worktree of this repo - answers typecheck:null with the warning `tsc is not on PATH or in node_modules/.bin` even though `npx tsc` resolves there. Reproduced live on a fixture: ancestor/node_modules/.bin/{npx,tsc} + ancestor/sub/tsconfig.ci.json, --root ancestor/sub -> typecheck null. The failure direction is conservative (a nulled command, never an unreachable named one), so AC2 and RCH-01 hold.

truths.truth: The detect-commands test set is machine-independent - it passes with ruff/mypy/eslint/tsc/go absent and again with all five stubbed onto PATH (AC3)
truths.evidence: This machine has ruff, mypy, eslint, tsc and go all absent from PATH (verified with `command -v`). `node --test --test-name-pattern='detect-commands' cadence-core/bin/planning.test.mjs` -> tests 25, pass 25, fail 0. Re-run with a stub dir holding executable ruff/mypy/eslint/tsc/go prepended to PATH -> tests 25, pass 25, fail 0. Mechanism: the `detect()` harness (planning.test.mjs:5215-5227) passes EVERY_TOOL through CADENCE_DETECT_REACHABLE behind the CADENCE_TEST_SEAM sentinel; the override is read by presence, not through `||` (planning.mjs:2613-2618), and rows at planning.test.mjs:5403 and :5433 pin both the live probe (via a fixture's own node_modules/.bin) and the sentinel gate.

truths.truth: risk-check run --plan 1-fix records a row and risk-check status flips ok:false -> ok:true once the receipt lands under the same corr+key (AC4)
truths.evidence: Named test `risk-check status: a 1-fix bracket is satisfiable - record, then fire receipt` (plan-key.test.mjs:180-211) walks the whole loop in a scratch git repo: status -> ok:false reason risk-record-missing missing:['1-fix']; `risk-check run --phase 3 --plan 1-fix --base <sha> --head <sha>` -> ok:true; status -> ok:false reason risk-fire-missing; `trace append ... --plan 1-fix` -> status ok:true with plans[0].plan === '1-fix'. Ran: node --test cadence-core/bin/plan-key.test.mjs -> 16/16 pass. Also `risk-check run: a fix-pass key is RECORDED` (:166) asserts the trace record carries plan '1-fix' verbatim. Live read-only cross-check on this repo: `planning.mjs risk-check status --phase 3` -> ok:true, three plans, all state 'recorded'. Refused keys land in malformed[] rather than missing[] (planning.mjs:4157; test at plan-key.test.mjs:213).

truths.truth: Both risk-check faces reach the plan-key grammar through one exported predicate, and a test proves they cannot disagree (AC5)
truths.evidence: One home: cadence-core/bin/lib/plan-key.mjs:65 exports requirePlanKey; the only production importer is planning.mjs:192, called at :3761 (`risk-check run`), :3983 (`risk-check status` named-range arm) and :4157 (the bracket walk). No surviving requireInt on either --plan path (grep for requireInt(opts.plan) returns nothing). Cross-face test `every spelling in the table is accepted by BOTH faces or refused by BOTH` (plan-key.test.mjs:243-270) drives all 16 table rows through both CLI faces and asserts runRefused === statusRefused; it passes. helper-census.test.mjs:141-148 registers lib/plan-key.mjs as the single home for the grammar.

truths.truth: scanDiff over whole-file adds of lib/risk-diff.mjs and risk-diff.test.mjs returns zero matches under both this repo's three surfaces and all eight, and the fix is pinned by a test that reddened pre-fix (AC6)
truths.evidence: Independent probe (my own harness, not the repo's): scanDiff(wholeFileAdd(...)) over the current bytes of both files -> matches [] for scope ['secrets','destructive','untrusted_input'] (read from .planning/config.json) and [] for all eight. Falsifier re-run against the pre-phase blobs at 0e7844b: lib/risk-diff.mjs matched auth, billing, migrations, concurrency, destructive, untrusted_input (6) and risk-diff.test.mjs matched auth, migrations, destructive, untrusted_input (4) - so the census row was watched failing for real. Pin: `the census: neither this file nor the detector matches the detector` (risk-diff.test.mjs:1245-1258), asserts r.checked and r.matches === [] over 4 file x scope pairs with a `ran === 4` guard; passes. Reach unchanged, checked by reading the diff of lib/risk-diff.mjs 0e7844b..HEAD: every edit is either a one-character class (`[s]tripe` for `stripe`, `[M]utex`, `[b]odyParser`) or a split label literal ('an Authorization' + ': Bearer header'), both of which preserve the matched language and the emitted signal bytes exactly. No path or filename exemption was added.
